feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 18 September 2026 5:21am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 18 September 2026 at 5:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Gales.


##Synopsis##

Deepening Atlantic low will push frontal troughs across the Irish Sea today and tonight.


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, briefly decreasing West or Southwest 4 or 5 around dawn, before gradually increasing Southwest 6 or 7 through this morning and occasionally gale 8 in the afternoon, especially in east of area. Becoming Southwest 6 occasionally 7 in the evening, then West or Southwest 5 or 6 later tonight.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, building moderate or rough.


##Weather##

Rain spreading from the west, turning patchy later in day then clearing tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Southwest 5 or 6.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, soon becoming moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
